lessons.role: Compare everyday activities with a classmate after school
lessons.opening: まいにち にほんごを べんきょうします。
objectives: Describe a daily study habit with a polite ～ます verb
Say where Aki works using で and who you will speak with using と
Distinguish tomorrow’s conversation from an everyday habit
lessons.complication: The classmate asks whether the conversation happens every day or tomorrow.
lessons.closure: Add one more activity using ほんも よみます。

lessons.role: Plan a shared afternoon with a study partner
lessons.opening: ひるごはんを たべます。
objectives: Say what you will eat and drink with polite verbs
Place watching a film after lunch using そのあと
Confirm that a friend comes and you study together
lessons.complication: Your partner asks whether the film comes before or after lunch.
lessons.closure: Confirm いっしょに べんきょうします。

lessons.role: Explain yesterday’s activities and today’s plan to a classmate
lessons.opening: きのう としょかんに いきました。
objectives: Report going to the library and reading a book yesterday
Say that you did not watch a film using ～ませんでした
Contrast today’s negative plan with homework to do later
lessons.complication: The classmate assumes you watched a film yesterday.
lessons.closure: State that you will do homework later.

lessons.role: Choose a study room with another student
lessons.opening: この へやは おおきいです。
objectives: Compare the large room with the small one
Describe a quiet room with しずかな before へや
Distinguish the lively room next door from the clean new desk
lessons.complication: The other student confuses room size with how quiet it is.
lessons.closure: Confirm which room is quiet before choosing it.

lessons.role: Sort belongings with a classmate after class
lessons.opening: この かばんは だれのですか。
objectives: Ask whose bag and umbrella these are using の
Distinguish Tanaka’s item from the teacher’s
Describe the bag as not big and the pen as not good
lessons.complication: A classmate assumes the umbrella also belongs to Tanaka.
lessons.closure: Locate your book in the bag.

lessons.role: Check supplies with a partner before a lesson
lessons.opening: ノートは ありますか。
objectives: Ask whether a notebook is available
Check whether a dictionary is needed today and answer with いりません
State that a pencil is needed using いります
lessons.complication: Your partner brings a dictionary that is not needed today.
lessons.closure: Repeat the one supply still needed: えんぴつが いります。

lessons.role: Arrange a station-to-school trip with a friend
lessons.opening: あした えきに いきます。
objectives: Say you will go to the station tomorrow
Confirm that a friend comes to the station
Describe going from there to school and returning home later
lessons.complication: The friend asks whether the final destination is school or home.
lessons.closure: Answer どこへ いきますか。 with the next destination.

lessons.role: Choose a book with another reader
lessons.opening: なにを よみますか。
objectives: Ask what the partner will read using なに
Identify the blue book with どの and あおい
Choose among three colored books using どれ
lessons.complication: The partner points to several books rather than one.
lessons.closure: State which of the red, white, or black books you choose next.

lessons.role: Schedule a study session with a classmate
lessons.opening: いつ べんきょうしますか。
objectives: Ask when the session will happen using いつ
Explain why tomorrow works using どうして and から
Ask where to study using どこで and name the library
lessons.complication: The classmate proposes today, when you are busy.
lessons.closure: Confirm としょかんで べんきょうします。

lessons.role: Agree on a meeting time at the station
lessons.opening: あした なんじに あいましょうか。
objectives: Ask what time to meet tomorrow
Agree on 15:10 using ごご さんじ じゅっぷん
Confirm the place in front of the station and the 16:30 return
lessons.complication: The partner repeats the time without the afternoon marker.
lessons.closure: Confirm that よじはん is the return time, not the meeting time.
